ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a set of upper and lower blue line segments, both of which have the same pink arrow markings on them, indicating that they are parallel to each other. On the left side there is a slanted side connecting the upper and lower parallel lines, forming same-side interior angles; the upper-left angle is labeled (5y)°, and the lower-left angle is labeled 120°. The figure is also labeled with the upper-right angle (2x)° and the lower-right 108°, but they do not need to be used when finding y. Then reason: Because the upper and lower lines are parallel, and the left slanted side is a transversal, the upper-left angle (5y)° and the lower-left angle 120° are a pair of same-side interior angles, and same-side interior angles are supplementary. Therefore: 5y + 120 = 180. Solving gives 5y = 60, so y = 12.
